title: Apex Bio-Pharmaceuticals (ABP) — Automated Lab Expansion Case Study
overviewSummary: Apex Bio-Pharmaceuticals (ABP) operates diagnostic testing laboratories. It is considering a $1.2m investment in automated AI diagnostic robotics vs hiring 25 specialised laboratory technicians, whilst facing rising regulatory hurdles and tight liquidity.
backgroundStory: ABP was founded 15 years ago and became a Plc 5 years ago. It supplies 60 regional hospitals with diagnostic blood test analysis. Demand has grown 35% annually, but test turnaround bottlenecks have caused hospital complaints.
operationsAndWorkforce: ABP employs 180 laboratory staff. Staff turnover is 11%, but wages for specialised technicians have risen 14% this year due to national labour shortages. Option 1 involves purchasing four robotic testing analyzers at $300,000 each. Option 2 involves hiring 25 technicians on 3-year contracts.
marketAndStrategy: ABP operates in a regulated oligopoly with two major multinational competitors. Hospital procurement teams prioritize test precision and turnaround speed over lowest price.

appendices.title: Appendix 1: Cost & Throughput Comparison
appendices.content: Operational comparison between Robotic Automation vs Expanded Human Technician Workforce.

applicationHooks: Option 1: $1.2m automated robotics (0.02% error rate, 12,000 capacity)
Option 2: 25 new technicians ($850k annual salary, 0.85% error rate)
Hospital contracts depend on 24-hour turnaround speed
Net profit margin squeezed from 11.2% to 8.4%

questions.questionText: Explain two factors ABP should consider before introducing robotic automation to replace human lab analysis.

rubric.sampleStrongAnswer: Capital cost of $1.2m must be weighed against ABP's declining profit margins...

questions.commandWord: Evaluate Option 1 vs Option 2 and recommend
questions.questionText: Consider Option 1 (investing $1.2m in robotic automation) and Option 2 (hiring 25 lab technicians). Recommend which option ABP should choose. Justify your answer.

indicativeContent: Evaluate technician flexibility and lower initial capital
Justified decision based on hospital quality criteria
rubric.sampleStrongAnswer: Option 1 robotics is recommended because hospital diagnostic accuracy is paramount...
